role: Visual Target Director / independent catalog reviewer
basePartitionCoverage: 48/48 unique IDs reviewed; exact legacy/current decisions remain in immutable prior revisions

contractEvidence.rule: Actual rendered pixels and exact hashes are required; source/XML/no-clipping alone is not acceptance.

priorCurrentReplacementEvidence.note: Do not redo unchanged accepted hashes.

newReplacementReviews.name: Art Smock
newReplacementReviews.reason: Smock identity and art marks read, but the garment remains a frontal layered vector panel. Tier 3 still lacks apron/smock construction depth, fabric folds, pocket/tool volume, three-quarter form and convincing material/contact lighting.

newReplacementReviews.name: Star Bomber
newReplacementReviews.reason: Star-bomber identity and neon palette are readable, but Tier 4 is still a flat frontal jacket with line-art glow. It needs true bomber volume, ribbed cuffs/waist, zipper/hardware depth, differentiated materials and controlled neon rim/specular lighting.

newReplacementReviews.name: Cloud Jacket
newReplacementReviews.reason: Cloud/puff elements add some volume, but the jacket body still reads as a flat pastel vector construction. Tier 4 needs stronger body/sleeve depth, seams/hardware, plush-vs-shell material separation, three-quarter presentation and more coherent Candy Core lighting.

newReplacementReviews.name: Star Coat
newReplacementReviews.reason: Long-coat/star identity is clear, but the highest tier remains a flattened vector/card treatment. It needs layered lapels/trim, real coat thickness and folds, premium hardware/material response, Adventure Club-specific construction detail and Tier-5 hero lighting/perspective.

handoff.08: Preserve/integrate Tops 1-6 ACCEPT hashes only after normal metadata/file/content checks; Tops 7-12 current hashes are not eligible.
handoff.15: Route exact Tops 7-12 REWORK to producer 09 in bounded new versions. Tops 7/8 already have newer generated-but-not-staged v3 candidates; do not ask reviewer 01 to review them until exact repository hashes and rendered pixels exist.
handoff.next01Review: Fresh replacement hashes for Tops/Bottoms/Headwear/Facegear take priority. Do not redo unchanged Tops 1-6.
